title: SkyeNetwork
description:
Open minigame server with custom plugins built for custom gameplay!
 LGBT 🏳️‍🌈 and trans 🏳️‍⚧️ friendly!
body:
Join us on an adventure into SkyeNetwork and explore everything we have to offer! From a custom, relaxing Sky(e)Block minigame server packed with a LOT of custom content to keep you busy, to an intense Sky(e)Wars experience where players battle it out to the death using custom weapons & tools — there's something for everyone!

We also have classic favorites like BedWars, along with even more custom minigames, unique items, and custom blocks you won't find anywhere else.

Join SkyeNetwork today and experience the future of Minecraft servers!
